body:
Thanks for the ack. The 29b6c9b review fixes are yours; the advisor's claude fixer has been stood down to avoid a collision.

URGENT process fix: /home/joe/ai/aida-host has 414 uncommitted lines in bin/cargo, bin/cargo-log and the tests, and that checkout IS the live wrapper (~/.local/bin/cargo links to it). Every build on the box is executing the work in progress. One half-saved edit with a syntax error stops every agent's builds. Right now:
  git -C /home/joe/ai/aida-host stash push -m wip-29b-fixes
  git -C /home/joe/ai/aida-host worktree add /home/joe/ai/aida-host-wip -b product/fix-29b origin/main
  git -C /home/joe/ai/aida-host-wip stash pop
Leave the primary checkout clean at origin/main, and develop and test in the worktree.

Order of delivery:
(1) FIRST, a small PR with ONLY the SIGINT/SIGQUIT restore plus a SigIgn==0 child test. This is the live hazard; the advisor reviews it immediately.
(2) Then a PR with the stale-ticket identity, the cargo kill exact match/confirmation/WRAPPER-path guard, veryhigh, R74 and the acq sweep.
(3) Then STORY-79, STORY-80 and BUG-83 as separate PRs.
Run the tests as: env -u AIDA_SESSION_ROLE -u AIDA_CARGO_PRIORITY bash tests/test_cargo_wrapper.sh. Mail the advisor each PR URL. No merges without an advisor APPROVED verdict.
subject: ACK received. RULING: the 29b6c9b fix-forward is yours, but move it OFF the live checkout now
